title: New Hospital, Lower Water Bills, Dam Payments
summary:
*   **Addressing Dam Impacts:** Payments were approved for landowners whose properties were perpetually flooded by the city's recently rebuilt dam.
*   **Equipping a New City Hospital:** Contracts were awarded to furnish the New City Hospital with furniture and essential surgical and sanitary equipment.
*   **Reduced Water Rates:** A significant policy change lowered the minimum water rate for citizens, effective January 1915.
*   **Major Infrastructure Investments:** Substantial funds were allocated for expanding water, light, and power utilities, alongside improvements for city streets and bridges.

.. Regular meeting of the City Council: Austin, Texas, December 31, 1914

The Council was called to order by the Mayor: Roll called: Present Mayor Wooldridge,
Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Absent none.

On motion the reading of the minutes was postponed until the next regular meeting:

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution: Resolved by the City Council
of the City of Austin: That the sum of two hundred and twenty five ($ 225.00) dollars be
and the same is hereby appropriated out of the appropriation in the budget of the City of
Austin, Texas, for the year 1914 to pay for overflowed lands caused by rebuilding the dam,
and made payable to the order of W B Anthony and C B Moreland in payment of a perpetual
easement over and upon their lands overflowed by the lake formed by the rebuilt dam. For
full particulars as to the land conveyed and the terms of the deed, reference is here made
to the deed of said W B Anthony and C B Moreland to the City of Austin, Texas, dated
December 20th 1914, and by reference made a part of this resolution.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 4 Present but not voting, Councilman Anthony 1
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

Councilman Haynes presented bills from the Citizens Bank & Trust Co for interest on
overdrafts General Fund $ 62.60 & bill overdraft Street Improve-ment for for $ 6.13, which
were allowed and ordered paid.
Councilman Anthony presented the following resolution: Resolved by the City Council of the
City of Austin: That the bid of C A Dahlich, per report of the Supt of Police & Public
Safety, of date December 12th, 1914, to supply certain furniture to the New City Hospital,
amounting, per said report, to $ 393.15, is hereby accepted. Resolved further: That the
bid of the Swan Furniture Company to supply certain furniture to the New City Hospital,
per the report of the Supt of Police & Public Safety in the amount of $ 1,124.47, be and
the same is also hereby accepted.
Be it further resolved:
That the bid of the Swan Furniture Company to supply Surgical and Sanitary equipment to
the New City Hospital, per the report of the Supt of Police & Public Safety, of date
December 12th 1914, in the amount of $ 821.96, be and the same is hereby accepted.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 6 Nays none.
